fnol_text: My name is Bianca Haddad and I live at 223 Briar Road, Ashland, OR 97599. You can reach me on (555) 320-3749 or bianca.haddad@example.com. The Fenley Creek burst its banks on 14 August 2023 and the water came right up the garden and into the house. The ground floor was under about 40 cm of water. Policy HH-2023-00103. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Haddad on (555) 320-3749 to acknowledge the claim. Bianca confirmed the loss date as 14 August 2023.
Site visit to 223 Briar Road. Neighbour Grace Ishikawa was present and confirmed the timeline.
Bianca sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
